description: Vector database agent — nVDB v2 (nvdb serve HTTP) hybrid lexical + dense + Level-2 ONNX reranked search over storage files and memories. Syncs storage files asynchronously and exposes ranked search across collections. Directories and files can be excluded via .nvdb_ignore files or agents.vdb.ignore.

tools.name: vdb_search
tools.description: Hybrid lexical + dense + Level-2 reranked search via nVDB v2. Supports exact titles, paths, German compounds, 1-edit fuzzy typos, and native folder/extension pre-filters. To browse the full directory tree use storage.list instead.

query.description: Search query or natural language question.

collections.description: Collections to search. Default: all enabled collections.

folder.description: Filter to a specific top-level folder (storage).

extension.description: Filter to files with this extension, e.g. 'md' or '.md'.

top_k.description: Number of top matches to return.

include_content.description: If true, include the matched chunk text in results.

search.description: Optional per-request layer switches for A/B (dense, lexical, diversity, rerank, rrfK, candidateK, vectorWeight, lexicalWeight, maxPerDocument, shortlist, rerankWeight).

tools.name: vdb_status
tools.description: Show nVDB v2 server status: health, reranker state, collections, document counts, pending embeddings sample, and last sync stats.

tools.name: vdb_trigger_scan
tools.description: Manually sync watched storage files to nvdb serve and drain pending embeddings.

tools.name: vdb_build_index
tools.description: Commit all open collections in nvdb serve (v2 uses flat SIMD scan below flat_search_cutoff).
